items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: So they fired me and they took Paul Barbaran... T-Bar Barbaran was living on St. Claude... T-Bar Barbaran getting up there and making a whole lot of monkeys shine... We want Chinese back. We want Chinese back. So he says, the band wants you to come back

ctx.x: Did you ever sit in with them? Oh, no, I wasn't, I was not playing music then.

Oh, I see. I was a kid. Oh, I didn't hear that. I know Bunk, when he saw Barney in San Francisco, that was 15 years ago, he said to Barney, you won't remember me, but I remember you. And I used to go to your uncle's house. Okay, yeah. He played violin. He told Barney all about his family more than Barney could remember, he said. That's right. And he said he remembers Barney being a little kid playing around there, but Barney wouldn't remember Bunk. I was a kid too, and I used to admire when my uncle would have…
Who did he play with him?
